sections.heading: Data Controller
sections.body: Bureau Point Fixe is the data controller for the personal data collected through this website.

sections.heading: What We Collect
sections.body: When you use the contact form, we collect the information you provide: name, work email, organisation (optional), your message, and phone number (optional).

sections.heading: Why We Collect It
sections.body: Your information is used only to assess and respond to your enquiry and to manage any related pre-contractual exchange. It is not used for marketing purposes.

sections.heading: Legal Basis
sections.body: Processing is based on our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries and, where relevant, on steps taken at your request prior to entering into a contract (GDPR Article 6).

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Enquiry data is kept only for as long as necessary to handle the enquiry and any resulting engagement. [Exact retention period to be confirmed.]

sections.heading: Recipients
sections.body: Your data is accessed only by Bureau Point Fixe. It is not sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes. The contact form is processed using EmailJS, a third-party email delivery service, solely to route your enquiry to Bureau Point Fixe.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website does not use analytics or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body:
Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase and object to the processing of your personal data, and the right to data portability.

Please do not send classified information or special-category personal data through the contact form.
